title: Compare two texts
summary: A line-by-line unified diff of two texts.

sections.use: Show exactly which lines changed between two versions of a text, as a unified diff with three lines of context. Pairs with compare_documents_meaning for the substantive differences.
sections.exclusions: Not a comparison of meaning: rewording a sentence shows as a removed and an added line.
sections.limitations: Each text up to 1 MiB and 5,000 lines. Texts that differ in too many lines are refused as too_large. Differences only in line endings or the final newline are not reported.
sections.missing_data: Identical texts give changed false and an empty diff.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

outputs.out: changed, the unified diff and the counts of added and removed lines.
